title: The Reasonable Effectiveness of Diverse Evaluation Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating annotator perspective and disagreement by calculating the pairwise Hamming distance between AI chatbot safety ratings provided by male versus female raters.
Evaluating regional annotator differences by measuring the pairwise Hamming distance between chatbot safety ratings from US raters versus Indian raters.
Comparing within-group and cross-group coherence of safety annotations across two different crowdsourcing rater pools that represent varying socio-economic backgrounds.
